name: flow-panel
description: Animated node graph of Claude's work: you, Claude, sub-agents, tools, MCP servers and skills, with the 5-hour limit growth and a per-path cost estimate in percent.

guardedHooks.title: Hooks a guard skips
guardedHooks.description: Off (default): the mod adds no classic.Stop hook, so an organisation's guard has nothing to skip and nothing is written into the chat. The cost: a background task that ended is noticed from the transcript row instead of the Stop event, a little later.
